description.zh:
组件类型。

取值范围：
- Build
- Test
description.en:
The component type.

Valid values:
- Build
- Test.

description.zh:
组件版本号，格式为major.minor.patch，均为非负整数，也支持使用通配符“*”来替代其中一位进行模糊匹配版本。
>仅当指定Name时该参数生效。
description.en:
The component version number in the major.minor.patch format. Each part must be a non-negative integer. You can also use the wildcard character (*) to replace one part for fuzzy matching.
>This parameter takes effect only when Name is specified.

description.zh: 待查询的镜像组件ID。N取值范围：1~20
description.en: The ID of the image component to query. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

description.zh:
分页查询时每页行数。取值范围：1~500

默认值：50。
description.en:
The maximum number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: 1 to 500.

Default value: 50.

description.zh: 镜像组件名称。仅支持精确查找。
description.en: The image component name. Only exact match is supported.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的`NextToken`参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数。
description.en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken returned by the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request.

description.zh:
镜像组件类型。取值范围：

- SELF：您创建的自定义镜像组件。
- ALIYUN：阿里云提供的系统组件。
description.en:
The image component type. Valid values:

- SELF: custom image components that you created.
- ALIYUN: system components provided by Alibaba Cloud.

description.zh: 所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
资源组ID。使用该参数过滤资源时，资源数量不能超过1000个。

>不支持默认资源组过滤。
description.en:
The resource group ID. If you use this parameter to filter resources, the resource count cannot exceed 1,000.

>Filtering by the default resource group is not supported.

description.zh:
组件支持的操作系统。

取值范围：
- Linux
- Windows
description.en:
The operating system supported by the component.

Valid values:
- Linux
- Windows.
The tag key. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.
The tag value. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

title.zh: 查询镜像组件的详细信息

descriptions.zh: 您可以设置`NextToken`查询凭证（Token），其取值是上一次调用DescribeImageComponents返回的`NextToken`参数值，再通过`MaxResults`设置单页查询的最大条目数进行查询。
descriptions.en: You can set NextToken to the value of NextToken returned by the previous call to DescribeImageComponents, and set MaxResults to specify the maximum number of entries per page.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-image-components --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --name testComponent --next-token AAAAAdDWBF20000 --max-results 50 --owner SELF --image-component-id ic-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --component-type Build --system-type Linux --component-version 1.0.0 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs DescribeImageComponents --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key TestKey --Owner SELF --ComponentType Build --ResourceGroupId 'rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --NextToken AAAAAdDWBF20000 --MaxResults 50 --Tag.1.Value TestValue --SystemType Linux --ImageComponentId.1 'ic-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Name testComponent --ComponentVersion '1.0.0'
